Title: Public preview: Azure Purview is now available in the Central India region

Body.Content:
Azure Purview, the unified data governance service that helps customers maximize the business value of data is now available in the Central India, in public preview. Get started by creating a Purview account, see Quickstart: Create an Azure Purview account in the Azure portal.

For the full set of regions that Azure Purview is currently available in as a public preview offering, see Azure Purview Availability.
